long_description:
Dear Parents,

We are excited to announce that *Silicon Andhra ManaBadi - Telugu Maatlaata 2027* will take place on *DEC 5th* at 

*BASIS Shavano Campus*

4114 Lockhill Selma Rd, 

San Antonio, TX 78230.

Maatlaata is a fun and enriching Telugu language competition that helps students build confidence, language skills, and cultural connection. Last year’s event was a huge success, and we are looking forward to an even more engaging experience this year.

*Game Categories*

*Padarangam* – SpellingBee

*Tirakaatam*-Jeopardy‑style Quiz

*ONiMa* – One-minute impromptu speech

All competitions are open-book. Study materials and the MaayaaDarpanam practice app are available online.

*Telugu maatlaata website*: https://www.telugumaatlaata.com

*Registration*: https://telugumaatlaata.com/register/

*Practice App Mayadarpanam*: https://www.telugumaatlaata.com/practice/

*Age Groups*

 • *Budathalu* (5–7 years) – Padarangam not included

 • *Sisindreelu* (8–11 years)

 • *Chiruthalu* (12–16 years)

These categories give students a better chance to excel and prepare for the *International Finals*, which will be held in *San Jose, CA, on July 3-4, 2027.*

We encourage all parents to register their children and support them in practicing for this exciting and rewarding event. Let’s make Maatlaata 2027 a memorable celebration of learning and fun!

Primary Lead: Pratyusha Talluri – (210) 904‑7295

Secondary Lead: Manjari Garimella – (210) 518‑9189 

Also check out other Contests in San Antonio.
